name: Watercolor Brush
mo_ta_vi: Trang sổ tay thuỷ màu tự vẽ từng nét cọ trên giấy ấm, ghi chú viết tay bên cạnh, không một đường vector nào.
summary: Self-painting watercolour journal: translucent brush strokes with flying white on warm paper, hand notes.
character: A hand-painted journal page that paints itself: translucent strokes with dry-brush flying white on warm cotton paper, structure before detail, a quiet annotation layer beside each subject. Calm, curious and precise; the paper is the white and the eraser.

palette.rule: Paper is the white, never paint pure white; 3-5 hues per scene plus ink; darker means more passes; one vermilion accent reserved for one recurring element.

typography: Be Vietnam Pro 600 for titles in ink on the paper, never in a box
Be Vietnam Pro 400 italic for notes beside a subject, revealed left to right like writing
Small tracked caps for measured labels; numbers as digits on screen
layout: Generous paper margins; one hero subject per view with its note
Parallax layers: farther is smaller, lighter and less saturated
Labels never cover the subject; a pen leader line joins note and specimen
material: One sheet of fibrous paper under everything (paper.jpg as a DOM image)
Variable-width stroke ribbons at partial opacity with 3-9 bristle tracks
Washes in 3 jittered passes so edges pool darker
texture: Paper fibres, smooth noise and light vignette baked into paper.jpg
Paper-coloured mist bands between depth layers
camera: Locked page or a slow continuous pan across one painted world
Gentle parallax between layers during holds
No hard cuts between unrelated pictures
transitions: brush-edge wipe (wavy vertical clip reveals the next scene)
mist erase (paper-coloured wash returns the world to paper)
continuous pan to the next painted area

pacing.rhythm: Unhurried: each object paints in over most of its shot, holds with a small sway, then the next thing paints in.

beat_response: Painting-in progress may step on beats, never pulse
A burst of strokes (under 1 s) for the one peak
No flashes, shakes or scale pulses
ui_choreography: UI only as a painted sketch of a screen with hand notes
Callouts are pen leader lines growing to the part
diagrams: Transect: a gradient read across space, palette carries the value
Specimen plate: one object dissected into labelled painted parts
Map whose fills change through time
character_motion: Figures painted in as silhouettes stroke by stroke, then a small sway
No limb animation rigs; change by repainting
captions: On the paper, no box: centred bottom, Be Vietnam Pro italic about 36 px, ink at 78% over a paper-coloured halo, 2 lines max
sound: Acoustic and gentle: felt piano, fingerpicked guitar, woodwinds, kalimba
Foley from the scene's matter: paper brush rustle per painting-in, pencil scratch for notes, soft stamp thump

signature_moves: Painting-in as reveal: structure first, then detail
Specimen with a hand-written note and leader line
Palette as data across a transect
strengths: Turns a gradient or a process into one readable painting
constraints: Engine is the lemo-opuscar watercolor stroke engine on a canvas under the DOM (lemo.mjs add --style watercolor)
Every stroke built once under withSeed; lemoRender(t, win) is a pure function of t
Cache finished objects as sprites; time strokes as fractions of a shot
All Vietnamese text in the DOM layer, never on the canvas
Do not copy the lemo demo film's story, scenes or end card
avoid: Vector outlines or a watercolour texture laid over flat vector art
Pure white paint, neon or glass
Hard video cuts and dissolves between unrelated pictures
